text: City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, referred Administrative Inquiry IA38.1 from Councillor Janet Davis, Ward 31, Beaches-East York regarding the Status of the Negotiations on Shared-use Agreements with the Toronto District School Board and Answer IA38.1a from the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, to the Community Development and Recreation Committee for consideration.

City Council on May 22, 23 and 24, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council request the Mayor to convene a meeting with the Chair, Toronto District School Board, the Director of Education, Toronto District School Board, the City Manager and the Deputy City Manager, Cluster A, to discuss the outstanding exclusive and shared-use agreements and leases.
